page.layout: One column of running text, with the page number and running head at the top. No marginal notes. Catchword "illud" at the lower right.

main_text.p: adsubstantiam rei, non autem ad ejus rei circumstantiam sive modum, non sim-pliciter obligari ad illum modum faciendi, quem verba insinuare videntur. Unde si in exemplo propofito totam trimestrem penfionem exhibuisset primo mense, fine dubio satisfeciset promissioni. Poterit tamen fieri, ut per accidens & ex conse-quenti obligetur & ad ipsum modum rei: quia unusquisque obligatur (caeteris paribus, & si nihil aliud impediat) eli-gere in dubiis id quod est tutius. Ut in exemplo jam allato certe tutius est pen-sionem eo modo quo promissa est sol-vere ; id est singulis mensibus decem potius quàm tertio mense triginta.Tùm ob[?] periculum repentinae mortis & in-certorum eventuum: tùm ad vitandum, qui vel ex neglecta circumstantia oriri possent, mentis scrupulos. Suaderem itaque homini pio, ut cujuslibet sui[?] voti, juramenti, pacti, promissionisque fidem exolvere studeat, juxta verborum & intentionis suae tenorem, quoad commodè fieri potest, etiam in levissimis circum-stantiis: ne minutiora ista contemnendo, aut scrupulos sibi creet non necessarios, aut rebus gravioribus contemnendis paulatim & sensim assuefcat[?]. Cæterum illud

page.notes: Short dash-like specks in the left margin (near "rei" and "faciendi") are paper marks, not text. The word "ob" after "triginta.Tùm" has a mark above the o that may be an abbreviation or a stain; it is transcribed as "ob[?]". "sui" before "voti" could be "fui" in the scan; transcribed as "sui[?]". "assuefcat" is uncertain at the start ("afluefcat" appears on the scan) and is marked [?]. Line ends: the printed hyphens in "pen-sionem", "sol-vere" and similar words are kept. Right edge shows the neighbouring page's edge, which is not transcribed.
